<script>
  class {
    init() {
      this.state.path = location.pathname
    }

    onMount() {
      this.on('pjax:render', (event) => {
        this.state.path = new URL(event.detail.to, location.href).pathname
      })
    }
  }
</script>

<span>Current page: {state.path}</span>
